_note: Exceptions for scripts/scan-german-ui.mjs, per app. words: look German to the lexicon (words in de.json that no other language file uses, or an umlaut) but are French/Spanish/English words or proper names. selectors: German on purpose (a German word being taught or compared, a German-speaker's typical mistakes). texts: regexes for whole strings that are multilingual by design (language names, the language offer).

_reasons.spanish: lingü: lingüístico/a is Spanish (ü is a diaeresis, not an umlaut); the scanner splits the word at ü
_reasons.italian: graubünden: proper name of the Swiss canton, used as such in English text
_reasons.italian: grü, ß: Grüß Gott, a real South Tyrolean greeting quoted on purpose in dialekte.m.tedesco (all languages)
_reasons.english: rate, boot, tag, spiel, art, ta: English words (and a name, Mei Chen) that are also German words; the scanner cannot tell
_reasons.english: doppelgänger, yüksek, türk, ü: doppelgänger is an English loanword; Ahmet Yüksek is a photo credit; Türkçe/üç are Turkish, shown on purpose on the languages page
_reasons.english texts: language offer: multilingual by design, like in the other apps
_reasons.english texts: Impressum, DSGVO, address: the German legal terms, the provider address and names of German exams/courses in the legal pages and About
_reasons.italian: words: Italian words (art., bei, alte, idee, infinite, formale, elementare, digitale, regionale, feste, telefonate, energie, probleme, sender) and English words (possessive, rate, browsers, hamster) that are also German; ü/Yüksek/Türk are a Turkish name and a photo credit; the scanner cannot tell
_reasons.italian: selectors: German on purpose: the German comparison words on /pronuncia (.pr-bridge-native, .pr-bridge-wrong)
_reasons.italian texts: language offer, legal: multilingual by design, and the German legal terms, address and exam/course names in the legal pages and About, as in the English app
_reasons.spanish: words: Spanish words (firma, dir-, den, diese/dieses, praxis, bis, tinte, por ende, alter ego, qu/gu/gü, finde, ...) and English words (hell, kinder, hamster, island, war, handy, bin, fallen, stock, male, browsers) that are also German; Ahmet Yüksek is a photo credit, Türkçe is Turkish on the languages page; lang/artikel are URL query parameters in the printed share link; the scanner cannot tell
_reasons.spanish: selectors: Deutsch/neu/Haus/Wasser are the German words compared on purpose on /pronunciacion and /conocimientos/lenguas; .sp-sheet-url is a URL
_reasons.spanish texts: language offer, legal: multilingual by design, and the German legal terms, address and exam/course names in the legal pages and About, as in the English app
_reasons.portuguese: words, selectors, texts: same exceptions as the Spanish app (the Portuguese app currently carries the same Spanish course content): Spanish/English words that are also German, the German comparison words on /pronuncia, the multilingual language offer and the German legal terms/address/exam names
_reasons.french: fallen, browsers, dient, ein: English words (fallen, browsers) and French strings (ein in the nasal vowel in/ain/ein; dient, a wrong-answer choice in the dire conjugation) that are also German; the scanner cannot tell
_reasons.french texts: Impressum, DSGVO, address,: the German legal terms, the provider address and names of German exams/courses in the legal pages and About, as in the English app
